summary: Q32 Bio Inc. filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing the appointments of Jos Trevejo, M.D., Ph.D., as Chief Medical Officer and Ellie Hershberger, Pharm.D., as Chief Development Officer, effective that date. The appointments, announced by press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1 under Regulation FD and Item 8.01, were not a forced or abrupt board-level departure but a planned executive build-out. No terms, price, stake, or advisor were disclosed. The event reflects a clinical-stage biotech deepening its development leadership; watch for pipeline execution or strategic review signals.
